title: POV: Black Friday Is 25 Days Away… and YOU Already Have $300 Ready 🛍️

lines: Black Friday is twenty five days away. And this year... you're not getting played.
scenes.img: {HERO} standing in front of a wall calendar with the 27th of November circled in red, confident smile, cozy apartment, vertical composition

lines: In twenty twenty four, Americans spent about ten point eight billion dollars online on Black Friday alone.
scenes.img: a young woman with a ponytail sitting on a sofa surrounded by delivery boxes, laptop full of shopping carts, excited but overwhelmed, vertical composition

lines: But here's the thing. One consumer study found ninety eight percent of those deals were the same price or cheaper at other times.
scenes.img: {HERO} holding a magnifying glass to a big sale price tag in a store, raised eyebrow, vertical composition

lines: So tonight, you write down the three things you actually need. Only three.
scenes.img: {HERO} writing a short list of three items in a notebook at a kitchen table in the evening, lamp light, vertical composition

lines: Then you check their prices today... and you screenshot them.
scenes.img: {HERO} sitting on a couch taking a screenshot of a product page on his phone, focused smile, vertical composition

lines: Every day until then, you put twelve dollars aside. Just twelve.
scenes.img: {HERO} dropping bills into a glass jar on a shelf, proud smile, vertical composition

lines: Black Friday morning. Is it on your list? Is it really cheaper? No? You close the app.
scenes.img: {HERO} calmly closing a laptop with a relaxed smile at a desk, in the background a woman with a ponytail frantically clicking on her phone, vertical composition

lines: You walk away with three hundred dollars, zero debt, and no regrets. The full No-Spend November plan is on my channel.
scenes.img: {HERO} walking out of a busy shopping mall with just one small bag, smiling, sunny day, vertical composition
